text:
15. In the case of an intimate search, the followi ng shall be recorded as soon as
practicable:
• the date the warrant was issued and the fact that the warrant was
produced.
• the fact that the appropriate consent was given b y the detainee to the
health care professional or (as the case may be) re fused, and if
refused, the reason given for the refusal (if any).
• which parts of the person’s body were searched;
• who carried out the search;
• who was present; and
• the result.
